title: Bookstore User Journey
description: Visualizes user flow, book popularity, and conversion revenue from OTel analytics.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT value) as count FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v2 WHERE tag_key = 'session.id' AND serviceName = 'web-ui'

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT sum(f64_tag_value) as revenue FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v2 WHERE spanName = 'purchase' AND tag_key = 'total_price'

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT spanName as event, count(*) as count FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v2 WHERE spanName IN ('app_start', 'cart_add', 'checkout_start', 'purchase') GROUP BY spanName ORDER BY count DESC

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT value as book, count(*) as views FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v2 WHERE spanName = 'book_view' AND tag_key = 'book_title' GROUP BY value ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10
